purpose: Bind the observed failure to release to the printed Slim faucet article.
user_report: On that last print of the faucet base on Mark 1, I was not able to remove the supports there. Even using a screwdriver to try to pry between the interface layers and the print.
observations: Supports did not separate cleanly under screwdriver prying.
Photographs show retained contact material and damage at the pried area.
inference: Explicit Slim roof generation did not establish physical release at this gap. The photographs alone do not separate thermal adhesion from mechanical engagement along the stepped curve.
